name: forkable-mcp
description: An MCP server whose login is Sign in with One. The agent writes a UI that renders inside Claude or ChatGPT and runs on the signed-in person's own accounts.

scripts.build:view: VIEW=runner vite build && VIEW=canvas vite build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:view && wrangler d1 migrations apply forkable-mcp --local && wrangler dev --port 52290
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:view && wrangler d1 migrations apply forkable-mcp --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test:render: node scripts/canvas.mjs && node scripts/web.mjs && node scripts/kit.mjs
